mapper.sql: COALESCE(SUM(u.call_count), 0) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(u.input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(u.cached_input_tokens), 0) AS cached_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(u.output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(u.estimated_cost_usd), 0) AS estimated_usd, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.estimated_cost_usd IS NULL THEN u.call_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpriced_calls
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage_record (occurred_at, usage_date, account_id, feature, operation, model, service_tier, call_count, input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, estimated_cost_usd, price_id) VALUES (#{occurredAt}, #{usageDate}, #{accountId}, #{feature}, #{operation}, #{model}, #{serviceTier}, #{callCount}, #{inputTokens}, #{cachedInputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{estimatedCostUsd}, #{priceId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, model_prefix, service_tier, input_usd_per_million, cached_input_usd_per_million, output_usd_per_million, effective_from, note, created_by_account_id, created_at FROM ai_model_price ORDER BY model_prefix, service_tier, effective_from DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model_price (model_prefix, service_tier, input_usd_per_million, cached_input_usd_per_million, output_usd_per_million, effective_from, note, created_by_account_id, created_at) VALUES (#{modelPrefix}, #{serviceTier}, #{inputUsdPerMillion}, #{cachedInputUsdPerMillion}, #{outputUsdPerMillion}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{note}, #{createdByAccountId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT u.feature AS group_key, FROM ai_usage_record u WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY u.feature ORDER BY estimated_usd DESC, calls DESC
SELECT u.model AS group_key, u.service_tier, FROM ai_usage_record u WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY u.model, u.service_tier ORDER BY estimated_usd DESC, calls DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT u.usage_date AS day, COALESCE(SUM(u.estimated_cost_usd), 0) AS estimated_usd, SUM(u.call_count) AS calls FROM ai_usage_record u WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY u.usage_date ORDER BY u.usage_date

SELECT u.account_id, a.email, p.plan_code, FROM ai_usage_record u JOIN account a ON a.id = u.account_id LEFT JOIN account_plan p ON p.account_id = u.account_id WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY u.account_id, a.email, p.plan_code ORDER BY estimated_usd DESC, calls DESC, u.account_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT cost_date AS day, SUM(amount_usd) AS estimated_usd, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM ai_cost_daily WHERE cost_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY cost_date ORDER BY cost_date
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_cost_daily WHERE cost_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_cost_daily (cost_date, project_id, line_item, amount_usd, fetched_at) VALUES (#{costDate}, #{projectId}, #{lineItem}, #{amountUsd}, #{fetchedAt})
